prompt: Create Angular 21 auth interceptor system with HttpContextToken SKIP_AUTH and comprehensive tests

assertions.name: functional-auth-interceptor
assertions.description: Auth interceptor is a function with HttpInterceptorFn signature, not a class

assertions.name: skip-auth-context-token
assertions.description: Defines SKIP_AUTH as HttpContextToken<boolean> with () => false default

assertions.name: context-token-check
assertions.description: Auth interceptor checks req.context.get(SKIP_AUTH) before adding header

assertions.name: inject-in-interceptor
assertions.description: Uses inject(AuthService) inside the interceptor function body

assertions.name: http-context-in-request
assertions.description: Service creates new HttpContext().set(SKIP_AUTH, true) for public endpoint

assertions.name: provider-ordering-correct
assertions.description: Tests have provideHttpClient() before provideHttpClientTesting() in providers array

assertions.name: with-interceptors-test-setup
assertions.description: Tests register interceptors via withInterceptors() in provideHttpClient()
